note: Proposed replacement for broker-config.json (not yet applied): raises max_tokens 4096 -> 8192 per autoresearch/TRACE-AUDIT-260925.md defect 6, which found 25/77 lift-GEPA, 18/60 lift-ada and 24/67 lift-evox responses truncated at the old cap (about $1.5 of spend wasted on truncated output). reservation_usd_per_request_conservative is recomputed from the new max_tokens via reservation_formula; max_requests is unchanged (the min(...,400) cap already binds at both max_tokens values, see contact_ceiling_raw). Written as a *.next.json, not applied in place, because broker-config.json's ledger (broker-ledger-gemini.json) already has real recorded spend/receipts from an approved live run; a human must review and copy these fields into broker-config.json (and re-run `python -m integrations.lift_backends approval-hash --write-material ...` for a fresh human approval) before any further live run. Defect-2's fix already moves live runs to per-arm ledgers (broker-ledger-gemini.<engine>.json), so applying this does not touch broker-ledger-gemini.json or its receipts.
